title: Asteroid Weapons
subtitle: Test your understanding of Asteroid Weapons — portal-delivered biological strikes, the firmament barrier, and the meteor myth.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Craters and fireballs in this account are the cover for a narrower strike. The meteor end and the nuclear end stay in the category of panic, while the farm still needs living ground.

questions.question: What are asteroid weapons actually made of and how do they arrive?

options.label: A
options.text: Kinetic munitions launched from hidden surface batteries toward chosen cities on the plain.
options.rationale: Kinetic munitions are part of the payload description, but they are fired through interdimensional portals, not from surface batteries.

options.label: B
options.text: Organic space rocks that break away in celestial space and fall through an open sky.
options.rationale: Organic space rocks are the rejected picture, and the firmament prevents space debris from entering the central realm.

options.label: C
options.text: Weather-array plasma gathered overhead and dropped onto the surface as a ball of fire.
options.rationale: The fire is a projected trail on the dome, while the payload is a synthetic biological weapon sent through a portal.

options.label: D
options.text: High-speed synthetic biological payloads fired through interdimensional portals rather than organic space rocks.
options.rationale: Asteroid weapons are high-speed, synthetic biological payloads deployed by parasitic forces directly through interdimensional portals rather than organic space rocks.

questions.hint: Review the opening definition of these weapons.

questions.question: Why is natural space debris unable to enter the central realm?

options.label: A
options.text: The solid firmament blocks every outside object.
options.rationale: The solid structure of the firmament prevents any natural object or space debris from entering the central realm.

options.label: B
options.text: A dense ozone shell burns incoming rocks before they can reach the ground below.
options.rationale: The block is the solid structure of the firmament, not a gas layer that burns rocks on the way down.

options.label: C
options.text: Magnetic belts around the realm push off-world objects back out into the dark.
options.rationale: Outside objects are stopped by the impenetrable physical dome, not by magnetic belts.

options.label: D
options.text: Heat shields high in the air burn celestial matter to ash during the fall.
options.rationale: Celestial rocks cannot penetrate the firmament, so the stop is a solid barrier rather than heat on entry.

questions.hint: Review the boundary that surrounds the central realm.

questions.question: What does the projection dome do during one of these strikes?

options.label: A
options.text: It opens the gateway and pushes the payload through the atmospheric barrier.
options.rationale: Parasitic forces open localized portals for the payload, while the projection dome supplies the visual trail.

options.label: B
options.text: It bends the blast back down so the crater is cut wider.
options.rationale: The crater is carved by the impact, while the dome projects trailing fiery arcs across the inner dome.

options.label: C
options.text: It projects trailing fiery arcs so the strike is read as a falling meteor.
options.rationale: Holographic projection systems project trailing fiery arcs across the inner dome, and observers read them as natural falling stars or meteors.

options.label: D
options.text: It spreads the released agents across distant layers of the air.
options.rationale: The munition releases engineered biological agents on impact, while the dome projects trailing fiery arcs.

questions.hint: Separate the picture observers see from the gateway the payload actually uses.

questions.question: How are the depressions called asteroid craters formed?

options.label: A
options.text: They are sinkholes left after water is pulled out of the ground under a city.
options.rationale: The report ties these depressions to portal-delivered biological strikes rather than to drained ground.

options.label: B
options.text: They mark the entry vectors of portal-delivered biological strikes that detonate and carve the ground.
options.rationale: Asteroid craters mark the precise entry vectors of portal-delivered biological weapons, and the munitions carve out crater formations on impact.

options.label: C
options.text: They are collapsed volcanic vents opened by a heat strike from below.
options.rationale: The depressions are produced by high-velocity portal-delivered biological strikes, not by volcanic collapse.

options.label: D
options.text: They are dents left by iron-rich rocks that struck in an earlier age.
options.rationale: The craters do not result from celestial collisions, and natural space debris cannot enter the central realm.

questions.hint: Tie the hole in the ground to the path the payload took.

questions.question: Why do the controllers refrain from nuclear weapons?

options.label: A
options.text: The firmament sets an energy cap that nuclear fire would pass.
options.rationale: The limit is grow-space, not an energy cap, and nuclear weapons have never been manufactured or used.

options.label: B
options.text: The blast would shake the projection dome until the sky picture failed.
options.rationale: The restraint is the need for fertile grow-space, not the stability of the projection picture.

options.label: C
options.text: A detonation would leave a thousand-year wasteland and destroy fertile grow-space.
options.rationale: A nuclear detonation would create a thousand-year wasteland unusable for population harvesting, and the central farm requires fertile grow-space.

options.label: D
options.text: Surface groups hold a counter that can smother radioactive fallout.
options.rationale: Nuclear blasts are completely non-existent because they would ruin grow-space, not because surface groups can smother them.

questions.hint: Think about what a livestock farm still needs from the ground.

questions.question: How does this account explain ancient glass deposits and vitrified structures?

options.label: A
options.text: Lightning during a shift in the air fused the ground into glass on its own.
options.rationale: The report assigns the glass to directed energy weapons that alter subatomic and molecular cohesion.

options.label: B
options.text: Fallout from an ancient nuclear war left the melted stone behind.
options.rationale: Nuclear weapons have never been manufactured or used, and the glass came from directed energy weapons.

options.label: C
options.text: Directed energy weapons altered the cohesion.
options.rationale: Ancient glass deposits and vitrified structures were produced by directed energy weapons that alter subatomic and molecular cohesion without generating radioactive contamination.

options.label: D
options.text: Molten debris thrown out by a portal biological strike cooled into glass sheets.
options.rationale: Those deposits are tied to directed energy weapons, not to molten debris from a biological strike.

questions.hint: Review the mechanics section on vitrified structures.

questions.question: What role do networks such as Freemasonry play in the meteor story?

options.label: A
options.text: They brew the pathogens in surface laboratories before each portal strike.
options.rationale: The payloads come through portals, and Freemasonry is named for embedding false astronomical models into educational institutions.

options.label: B
options.text: They embed false astronomical models into educational institutions.
options.rationale: Controlling networks, including Freemasonry, reinforce the deception by embedding false astronomical models into educational institutions.

options.label: C
options.text: They dig bunkers so elite circles can ride out a real meteor strike.
options.rationale: Freemasonry is named for embedding false astronomical models, not for sheltering elites from real meteors.

options.label: D
options.text: They run the projection hardware that paints artificial weather on the dome.
options.rationale: The projection dome is the parasitic picture system, while Freemasonry is named for embedding false astronomical models into schools.

questions.hint: Review how the false sky model is passed through schools.

questions.question: What is the paranoia tactic for?

options.label: A
options.text: It manufactures threats such as nuclear war and meteoric extinction so fear produces compliance.
options.rationale: A paranoia tactic manufactures existential threats, such as nuclear war or meteoric extinction, to induce widespread fear and compliance.

options.label: B
options.text: It readies surface people for a physical rescue by an off-world fleet.
options.rationale: Rescue stories are a separate lure, while the paranoia tactic induces widespread fear and compliance.

options.label: C
options.text: It shifts attention from local illness onto a story about markets and debt.
options.rationale: The tactic induces widespread fear and compliance with threats such as nuclear war or meteoric extinction.

options.label: D
options.text: It steers public money into off-world defense projects and sky surveys.
options.rationale: The tactic is about fear and compliance, not about funding surveys, and the meteor threat is a space debris myth.

questions.hint: Review the pair of threats that scare people without a planetary-scale detonation.

questions.question: What is grow-space in this account?

options.label: A
options.text: An air layer tuned so the holographic sky picture stays bright.
options.rationale: The projection dome handles the sky picture, while grow-space is planetary surface area for human populations.

options.label: B
options.text: A mapped set of gateways where a portal can be opened without a miss.
options.rationale: Portals are the gateways, while grow-space is planetary surface area used to cultivate human populations.

options.label: C
options.text: Usable, non-irradiated surface used to raise populations, take labor, and harvest loosh.
options.rationale: Grow-space is usable, non-irradiated planetary surface area required to cultivate human populations, extract labor, and harvest loosh.

options.label: D
options.text: Underground growing halls kept for elite networks during a surface strike.
options.rationale: Grow-space is surface area for human populations, not an underground hall for elites.

questions.hint: Think of the ground the controllers still need if people are to be raised there.

questions.question: How are NESARA/GESARA and med-beds categorized?

options.label: A
options.text: Old frequency rites recovered so human bodies can be tuned back up.
options.rationale: The report calls them intelligence psyops that offer false hope without providing actual liberation.

options.label: B
options.text: Medical and ledger programs sent in to clean up after a payload strike.
options.rationale: They are classed with false rescue lures, not with cleanup after a biological strike.

options.label: C
options.text: Healing and money tools built by surface resistance groups for the public.
options.rationale: Those frameworks are intelligence psyops that offer false hope, not tools of a surface resistance.

options.label: D
options.text: Intelligence psyops that offer false hope.
options.rationale: NESARA/GESARA financial resets and regenerative med-beds are intelligence psyops that offer false hope without providing actual liberation.

questions.hint: Review the offers that promise rescue without liberation.

questions.question: What is the projected Project Blue Beam fleet?

options.label: A
options.text: A ground broadcast net that announces a coming rescue on local stations.
options.rationale: The fleet is a simulated holographic sky battle and fake alien invasion, not a ground announcement network.

options.label: B
options.text: A physical craft fleet preparing to breach the firmament from outside.
options.rationale: The report calls that fleet a simulated holographic sky battle rather than a physical off-world fleet.

options.label: C
options.text: A simulated holographic sky battle and fake alien invasion, not a physical off-world rescue fleet.
options.rationale: The projected Project Blue Beam fleet presents a simulated holographic sky battle and fake alien invasion rather than a genuine rescue force or physical off-world fleet.

options.label: D
options.text: An orbital beam grid built to swat portal payloads before impact.
options.rationale: Project Blue Beam is a simulated holographic sky battle, not a grid that intercepts payloads.

questions.hint: Separate a sky picture from a fleet that could cross the firmament.

questions.question: What are the manufactured existential panics coupled with?

options.label: A
options.text: Directed energy strikes that turn ancient stone to glass.
options.rationale: Directed energy weapons explain vitrified structures, while the panics are coupled with false rescue lures.

options.label: B
options.text: False rescue lures meant to hold people in deceptive hope.
options.rationale: These fear tactics are coupled with false rescue lures designed to trap populations in deceptive hope.

options.label: C
options.text: Portal payloads timed to carve a crater on the same night.
options.rationale: Portal strikes are the physical weapon, while the panics are coupled with false rescue lures.

options.label: D
options.text: Firmament closures scheduled to stop debris during the scare.
options.rationale: The firmament already blocks space debris, and the panics are coupled with false rescue lures.

questions.hint: Look at what sits beside the fear stories in the broader account.

questions.question: How do these payloads get past the barrier around the realm?

options.label: A
options.text: They arrive in chambers under the ground and skip the surface.
options.rationale: The payloads are propelled toward target locations on the surface and carve out crater formations.

options.label: B
options.text: They are sent through gateway breaches opened in the firmament.
options.rationale: Parasitic forces inject biological weapons through localized interdimensional gateway breaches opened across the firmament.

options.label: C
options.text: They stay non-physical in flight and turn solid when they hit.
options.rationale: The payloads are physical biological munitions propelled through interdimensional gateways, not matter that condenses on impact.

options.label: D
options.text: They slip the air by bending gravity around the falling body.
options.rationale: The bypass is a portal through the firmament, not a gravity bend around a falling rock.

questions.hint: Review the opening cut through the atmospheric barrier.

questions.question: What do manufactured existential panics do to surface inhabitants?

options.label: A
options.text: They stop people from building a device that could crack the dome.
options.rationale: The panics keep collective frequency suppressed, and the firmament is the impenetrable physical dome.

options.label: B
options.text: They push people onto institutional medicine as their main support.
options.rationale: The stated effect is to keep their collective frequency suppressed, not to assign them to one medical system.

options.label: C
options.text: They keep the collective frequency suppressed.
options.rationale: Meteor threats, viral outbreaks, and nuclear escalation are used to keep their collective frequency suppressed.

options.label: D
options.text: They mutate bodies so people are easier for falling rocks to harm.
options.rationale: The panics keep collective frequency suppressed, and natural space debris cannot enter the realm.

questions.hint: Review the line about meteor threats, outbreaks, and nuclear escalation.

questions.question: How do nuclear-war threats sit next to the space impact myth?

options.label: A
options.text: Sky impacts are portal strikes, while nuclear war is a dome picture.
options.rationale: Portal strikes are real local weapons, but the nuclear-war threat is a paranoia tactic, not a dome picture of a blast.

options.label: B
options.text: Nuclear war is a real blast risk, while sky impacts are holograms.
options.rationale: Nuclear blasts are completely non-existent, and both threats are a paranoia tactic.

options.label: C
options.text: Both are paranoia tactics that stir fear without a planetary-scale weapon.
options.rationale: The threat of nuclear war and the space impact myth are both driven by a paranoia tactic, without ever detonating a planetary-scale weapon.

options.label: D
options.text: Both are physical dangers that schools merely talk up.
options.rationale: Neither is a real planetary-scale weapon, and both are driven by a paranoia tactic.

questions.hint: Look for the shared tactic under both scares.

questions.question: What happens when a high-speed biological payload comes through a portal?

options.label: A
options.text: It hits the surface, detonates, releases engineered agents, and carves a crater.
options.rationale: Upon impact, these munitions detonate to release engineered biological agents, introducing new illnesses while carving out crater formations.

options.label: B
options.text: It trips a sky broadcast of a rescue fleet across the inner dome.
options.rationale: The impact releases engineered biological agents, while rescue fleets belong to separate false lures such as Project Blue Beam.

options.label: C
options.text: It breaks up high in the air and sheds spores into the ocean currents.
options.rationale: The payload is propelled toward the surface, where it detonates and carves out crater formations.

options.label: D
options.text: It shuts down directed energy weapons already working in that district.
options.rationale: Directed energy weapons are a different class of device, and the payload detonates to release engineered biological agents.

questions.hint: Follow the munition from the gateway to the ground.

questions.question: What is the Disclosure Project in this account?

options.label: A
options.text: A public project organized to take the projection dome down.
options.rationale: The report classes its disclosures as intelligence psyops that offer false hope without providing actual liberation.

options.label: B
options.text: A witness circle that exposes how portal strikes are delivered.
options.rationale: The Disclosure Project is grouped with intelligence psyops that offer false hope, not with an exposure of the portals.

options.label: C
options.text: A lab file that proves natural meteor showers are physical rocks.
options.rationale: Meteors are a fabricated space debris myth, and the Disclosure Project is an intelligence psyop that offers false hope.

options.label: D
options.text: An intelligence psyop whose disclosures offer false hope.
options.rationale: Disclosures from the Disclosure Project function as intelligence psyops that offer false hope without providing actual liberation.

questions.hint: Place it with the other offers that promise hope and do not liberate.

questions.question: What keeps the controllers from mass-extinction weaponry?

options.label: A
options.text: They need people for energy, labor, and child sacrifices.
options.rationale: Parasitic controllers rely on human populations for energy, labor, and child sacrifices, so mass sterilization would destroy that asset.

options.label: B
options.text: Surface governments hold treaties that ban those weapons.
options.rationale: The constraint is the controllers' reliance on human populations, not a treaty among surface governments.

options.label: C
options.text: Portal physics stops a large payload from crossing the breach.
options.rationale: High-speed biological payloads already cross portals, and the limit on mass extinction is reliance on human populations for energy, labor, and child sacrifices.

options.label: D
options.text: Secret surface factions keep shield arrays over the cities.
options.rationale: The limit is their reliance on human populations for energy, labor, and child sacrifices, not a surface shield.

questions.hint: Ask what they would lose if the human population were gone.

questions.question: What two jobs does the atmospheric projection dome do here?

options.label: A
options.text: It holds the air in and strains pathogens out of the wind.
options.rationale: The dome is an optical screen for artificial sky events and a cover for portal strikes, not an air filter.

options.label: B
options.text: It conceals portal strikes and shows artificial sky events.
options.rationale: The atmospheric projection dome that conceals portal strikes also functions as an optical screen for artificial sky events.

options.label: C
options.text: It turns cosmic rays aside and spreads sunlight over the realm.
options.rationale: Its named jobs are concealing portal strikes and serving as an optical screen for artificial sky events.

options.label: D
options.text: It anchors the firmament and produces the pull that holds the ground.
options.rationale: The firmament is the impenetrable physical dome, while the projection dome conceals portal strikes and shows artificial sky events.

questions.hint: Pair the cover for incoming strikes with the other pictures on that screen.

questions.question: What does reclassifying the craters change about the geological record?

options.label: A
options.text: They stand as evidence of targeted biological warfare strikes.
options.rationale: Physical craters across the globe stand as historical evidence of targeted biological warfare strikes rather than random astronomical collisions.

options.label: B
options.text: They show that old cultures mined with nuclear charges.
options.rationale: Nuclear weapons have never been manufactured or used, and the craters record targeted biological warfare strikes.

options.label: C
options.text: They show that off-world pull caused the shifts in the crust.
options.rationale: The firmament blocks outside objects, and the craters are evidence of targeted biological warfare strikes.

options.label: D
options.text: They show the crust was built mostly from sheets of melted glass.
options.rationale: Glass deposits are tied to directed energy weapons, while the craters are evidence of targeted biological warfare strikes.

questions.hint: Read the holes as records of a weapon, not of a random skyfall.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT named as an alleged salvation framework or false rescue lure?

options.label: A
options.text: Disclosures from the Disclosure Project offered as official revelation.
options.rationale: Disclosures from the Disclosure Project are intelligence psyops that offer false hope, unlike directed energy weapons.

options.label: B
options.text: NESARA/GESARA financial resets offered as a form of liberation.
options.rationale: NESARA/GESARA financial resets are named among alleged salvation frameworks that offer false hope without providing actual liberation.

options.label: C
options.text: Regenerative med-beds offered as healing for the population.
options.rationale: Regenerative med-beds are named with the false rescue lures, unlike directed energy weapons.

options.label: D
options.text: Directed energy weapons that vitrify stone without radioactive contamination.
options.rationale: Directed energy weapons alter subatomic and molecular cohesion, while NESARA/GESARA, med-beds, and the Disclosure Project are the false rescue lures.

questions.hint: Review the broader section that lists the false-hope offers.

questions.question: True or False: Natural space debris can enter the central realm through the firmament.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The solid structure of the firmament prevents any natural object or space debris from entering the central realm.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The solid structure of the firmament prevents any natural object or space debris from entering the central realm.

questions.hint: Review what the firmament does to objects from outside the realm.

questions.question: True or False: Nuclear weapons have never been manufactured or used.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Nuclear weapons have never been manufactured or used, because a detonation would destroy vital grow-space.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The report states that nuclear weapons have never been manufactured or used.

questions.hint: Review how nuclear weapons are described in the mechanics section.

questions.question: True or False: Parasitic controllers operate the Earth realm as a livestock facility.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Parasitic controllers operate the Earth realm as a livestock facility, which strictly dictates their choice of weaponry.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The report says parasitic controllers operate the Earth realm as a livestock facility.

questions.hint: Review the image used for how the realm is run.

questions.question: True or False: Weapons that cause long-term environmental sterilization are deployed to manage the central farm.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Weapons that cause long-term environmental sterilization are never deployed, because the central farm requires fertile grow-space.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Weapons that cause long-term environmental sterilization are never deployed, because the central farm requires fertile grow-space.

questions.hint: Review the weapon limits tied to grow-space.
